name: Google AI Studio
description: Get free access to Gemini 3.5 Flash, Gemini 3 Flash and Gemma 4 models. The free tier for Flash offers 5 requests per minute, 20 requests per day, and 250k input tokens per minute. Meanwhile the free tier for Gemma 4 offers 30 requests per minute, 14.4k requests per day, but (only) 16k input tokens per minute.
